title: gradient.rs lookup_by_iid contract void post-AddrForKey (destination[8..] no longer an IID)
description: lichen-node/src/gradient.rs:174 lookup_by_iid matches e.destination[8..]==iid. After v9ke, announce-installed gradient destinations are ygg_addr_from_pubkey(pubkey), whose low 8 bytes are bit-packed key material, NOT iid_from_pubkey — so lookup_by_iid silently misses every announce-populated gradient. No production caller today (only its own unit test at gradient.rs:327, which uses link_local(1) so destination[8..]==iid holds trivially). Latent silent-miss trap. Remove it or re-key it (resolve via pinned pubkey -> ygg_addr_from_pubkey, like pinned_pubkey_for_addr). Also the gradient.rs:75 doc comment 'Destination IID or full IPv6 address' is now stale. Low priority: no live caller.
